about.title: About Me
about.description: Senior Full-Stack .NET Engineer with expertise in .NET, React, Angular, and databases. Experienced across Fintech, Customer Experience Management (CXM), consulting, IoT, and HR software domains. Thrived in both large teams (30+ members) and small agile groups (5–10 members). Proven ability to lead teams, design APIs, and improve system performance. Passionate about learning and mentoring others.

infopulse.description: Built solutions for a Big Four accounting firm, refactored legacy .NET Core code, wrote unit tests with xUnit and Moq, performed code and design reviews, participated in planning.

oitl.description: Developed IoT web apps with .NET Core, Entity Framework, and React, optimized SQL Server databases, configured CI/CD pipelines in TeamCity and Octopus Deploy.

keepSolid.description: Reduced stabilization bugs to zero in 2 critical features, optimized MySQL databases, covered legacy code with unit tests.
